recipe.visualDefinition: A weathered, rectangular identification card with rounded corners, featuring a passport-style portrait on the left and structured administrative text on the right. The card is framed by a border of small black stars and includes a semi-transparent blue rubber-stamp overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait photo anchored to the left third of the card
Administrative text fields aligned to the right two-thirds
Star border framing the inner content area
Rubber stamp overlaying the central text block
Handwritten ink entries contrasting with printed type
coreInvariants: Off-white, aged paper texture with slight yellowing
Rounded corners on both the card and its inner frame
Consistent use of black ink for printed and handwritten elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait photo occupies the left-center, approximately 35% of the card width. Text fields occupy the remaining 65%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The passport-style portrait is the primary focal point due to its color and human subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait, moves right to the identification number, down through the personal details, and ends at the signature.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight margins with a balanced distribution of text and empty space between dotted lines.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (printed text, stars, and handwritten ink)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the paper and the black ink.
paletteRestrictions: Limit colors to aged paper tones, black, and one secondary stamp color

letterConstructionRules: Body text uses a typewriter-style monospace
Handwritten entries feature irregular stroke widths and natural ink bleed
Stamp text uses a bold, condensed sans-serif with distressed edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Signature features a stylized, oversized first letter and a trailing flourish
Stamp text has a slight arc and varying opacity
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, printed administrative type and organic, fluid handwriting.

preserve: The layout of the portrait vs text
The presence of a rubber stamp overlay

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary typewriter aesthetic for the body text.
Suitable base for the distressed rubber stamp text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an aged, cream-colored rectangular card with rounded corners. Include a border of small black five-pointed stars. On the left, place a square passport-style portrait of a person. On the right, add several rows of dotted lines and small printed headers in a black sans-serif font. The overall texture should look like old paper with slight stains.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add handwritten-style text in black ink on the dotted lines. Overlay a large, semi-transparent cyan rubber stamp in a bold condensed font across the center-right section, slightly tilted. Add a stylized signature at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the star border consistent and complete?
Does the stamp look like it was applied over the text?
Is the paper texture appropriately aged without being illegible?
Is the portrait framed correctly within the card layout?

adjustableVariables: Shape of the border icons (e.g., stars to circles)

mustAchieve: Tactile texture of ink on paper

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the handwritten text aligns with the dotted lines.
Verify the stamp transparency allows underlying text to be partially visible.
Check that the portrait has the lighting and quality of a physical photo print.
Confirm the rounded corners of the card are smooth and consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vintage document layout with a star border, a passport photo, and a contrasting rubber stamp overlay to create a personalized travel-themed identification card.
